ledger.note: Summer 590: Bahram Chobin takes Ctesiphon and proclaims himself king of kings. Bahram Chobin page: 'Bahram declared himself king of kings in the summer of 590'; 'Ctesiphon fell to Bahram'. He had rebelled in the east against Hormizd IV in the civil war that 'broke out in 589' (civil war page) and Khosrow II had fled to Byzantine territory. The year and the capital are the page's; the extent is the researcher's reading of the lands the pages say he held.

Pages re-read: Bahram Chobin (no mention of the Lakhmids, al-Hira or Arab clients) and the civil war page (al-Hira appears once, as Hormizd's refuge). DISAGREEMENT, partial: the reviewer's text and mine agree on the fix; I changed the quoted wording in the region texts because neither page contains the quotes 'during his reign, held Mesopotamia' / 'Bahram held Mesopotamia' that I had used; the pages say 'prepared to invade Bahram's territories in Mesopotamia' (Bahram Chobin) and 'invaded Bahram Chobin's territories in Mesopotamia' (civil war, 591). The civil war page also gives no year or month for Bahram becoming king; the 590 date rests on the Bahram Chobin page ('declared himself king of kings in the summer of 590'). ROUTE TO sasanian-empire (me-06-c): the 590 loss and 591 gains back should use the same minus-Lakhmid Babylonia. (2) Reviewer's confidence 3 to 2 on /ledger/2 and the 590 war start were already applied and are kept. (3) Thin item, Atropatene: the civil war page and the Bahram page were re-read. The Bahram page has him 'promoted to army chief (spahbed) of the North (Adurbadagan and Greater Media)' in 572 (Dara) but does not name Azerbaijan as his in 590; the civil war page has Vistahm and Vinduyih 'raising an army in Azerbaijan under the observation of the Byzantine commander John Mystacon' and Khosrow's men conquering 'northern Azerbaijan' in 591. Atropatene is therefore not drawn, and the land before the summer-590 accession (his revolt from Khorasan, then 'Media, where Sasanian monarchs, including Hormizd, ordinarily resided during summer') is not a separate keyframe because the pages date no holding before the accession.
